_readme: PROVISIONAL five-flow demand->supply pairing table (plan 2026-07-02-005, Unit 1).
Status: Stage 0 MEASUREMENT input for the demand-coverage instrument ONLY.
NOT scoring config. NOT hash-participating: this file is deliberately absent
from ScoringConfigInputs / compute_config_hash — committing or editing it must
never flip the config hash or require a re-pin. Promotion to a scoring seed
(digest field + hash block) happens only at the Phase B flip commit, if funded.
Authoring blindness (R1b-pin): Authored from registry gate predicates and
port-shape vocabulary only; no forensics miss list was consulted for pool
design (R1b-pin). This file is committed BEFORE any Unit 2 share computation
exists; the commit boundary is the evidence of ordering.
Anti-gaming bound (R1b-pin): each flow's supplier pool (union of its supplier
shapes over card_ports, distinct card_name) must be <= 2,000 cards. Measured
pool sizes at authoring time (2026-07-02 DB) are recorded in each flow's
'comment'. A pool that exceeds the bound at measurement time is excluded from
the funding numerator and reported as the 'indiscriminate matching' DECLINE
branch evidence.
Shape grammar (closed key set, validated by
port_graph/resource_flows.py::load_resource_flows):
port_type              (required) one of the card_ports port_type values
event_class            exact match on card_ports.event_class
event_class_prefix     prefix match (parametrized keywords: 'Flashback:3');
exactly one of event_class / event_class_prefix
cost_target            exact match on card_ports.cost_target
cost_target_not        negated exact match on card_ports.cost_target
zone_origin            exact match on card_ports.zone_origin
zone_destination       exact match on card_ports.zone_destination
valid_filter           exact match on card_ports.valid_filter
attr_kind              port_attributes.attr_kind the port must carry
(paired with attr_value_not_in)
attr_value_not_in      the carried attr value must NOT be in this list
card_types_not_contains  card-level narrowing: cards.types must contain
none of these tokens (e.g. one-shot Instant/Sorcery
token bursts are not repeatable fodder engines)
Consumer shapes are commander-side demand (mirroring the shipped registry
gate predicates: _gy_fuel_feeder_gate, _cost_payoff_gate, _tap_type_feeder_gate
etc. read exactly these cost_target/cost_subtype columns). Supplier shapes are
candidate-side supply, narrowed per R6 (recursion/token/undying shapes, never
'any creature' — the tribe-as-fuel falsification population must not match).

sacrifice_fodder.comment: Demand: non-self sacrifice costs (937 distinct commander-candidate cards carry the consumer shape; Yawgmoth's cost.sacrifice/other verified). Supply narrowed per R6 — NOT 'any creature': repeatable creature-token engines on permanents (1,794 cards; non-creature artifact-token subtypes and one-shot Instant/Sorcery bursts excluded), self-recursion from the graveyard (GY->Battlefield 47, GY->Hand 52; Gravecrawler shape), and Undying (22) / Persist (24). Measured supplier pool union: 1,938 distinct cards (bound <= 2,000).

discard_fuel.comment: Demand: discard costs (493 distinct cards carry cost.discard; the shipped _cost_payoff_gate reads the same shape with a cost_subtype refinement — the flow deliberately keeps the broader discard demand for measurement). Supply narrowed to cards that WANT to be discarded: graveyard-castable keywords (Madness/Flashback/Jump-start/Retrace/Unearth/Disturb/Escape/Embalm/Eternalize/Dredge — parametrized event_class values like 'Flashback:3' matched by prefix) plus self-recursion from the graveyard. Generic card draw (effect.Draw, 3,045 cards) deliberately EXCLUDED — it is hand refill, not discard fuel, and would blow the pool bound. Measured supplier pool union: 559 distinct cards (bound <= 2,000).

untap_capacity.comment: Demand: tap costs — cost.tap (4,013 cards, the commander's own {T} activations) and cost.tap_type (202 cards, tapXType 'tap N untapped SUBJECT you control' costs; the shipped _tap_type_feeder_gate reads exactly this shape). Supply: explicit untap effects (effect.Untap). Measured supplier pool: 415 distinct cards (bound <= 2,000).

life.comment: Demand: life-payment costs (cost.pay_life, 195 distinct cards; Yawgmoth's PayLife$ 1 verified). Supply: lifegain effects (effect.GainLife, 1,486 cards) plus Lifelink keyword carriers (355 cards, prefix-matched for parametrized grants). Measured supplier pool union: 1,834 distinct cards (bound <= 2,000).

graveyard_bodies.comment: Demand: graveyard-exile costs with external targets — cost.exile_from_grave with cost_target 'any' (115 cards; mirrors the shipped _gy_fuel_feeder_gate exactly, self-target escape-style recursion excluded as a different archetype) plus cost.exile_any_grave (16 cards). Araumi of the Dead Tide's encore-granting kit is covered: her demand surfaces as cost.exile_from_grave/any (verified in card_ports), so no granted-keyword consumer shape is needed in the provisional draft. Supply: graveyard fillers — mill effects (effect.Mill, 503), entomb-style Library->Graveyard tutors (ChangeZone 49 incl. ChangeZoneAll), and Dredge carriers. Measured supplier pool union: 565 distinct cards (bound <= 2,000).
